#: Sliced menus: where each ' | ' item of the English starts. A number is the original column (12 px cell) of the JP item: tools/insert.py blanks the menu's run, then puts {tab:n} before each item (room: up to the next item's column). [n, px]: column n with px of room, for a window re-laid for the English (tools/winmap.py; menu_82C4DD: the shadow of Right Shoulder's last letter lands under the R of Right Arm). A string is put before the item as it is (for menus laid out in lines).
